meta.title: Renter households for a CHFA-style capture rate
meta.method: Qualified renters for a unit = sum over CHAS income tiers of (tract CHAS renter households in the tier) x (share of PUMS renter households in that tier, in the tract's PUMA, whose size fits the unit and whose income is between the 40%-of-income rent floor and the AMI limit). Rules from CHFA QAP Appendix A, Market Study Guide.
meta.rules_source: CHFA Housing Tax Credit Qualified Allocation Plan 2025-2026, second amendment, Appendix A Market Study Guide, section 7 Demand Analysis

chas.name: HUD CHAS 2018-2022, tract renter households by HAMFI tier

pums.name: Census ACS 2020-2024 5-year PUMS, Colorado housing file

tract_puma.name: Census 2020 tract to 2020 PUMA relationship file

limits_for_pums.name: CHFA 2024 income limits (50% AMI by household size), matching the 2024 dollars of PUMS incomes

meta.renters: PUMS TEN 3 (rented) or 4 (occupied without payment of rent); housing units only
meta.pums_layout: pumas[puma][size 1..6+][bin]; bin i = income i% to i+1% of the size-adjusted AMI; last bin = above 120%; weights are PUMS household weights
meta.limits_layout: puma_lim50_2024[puma] and county_lim50_2024[fips] = 50% AMI income limit for 1..8 people, 2024 dollars
meta.limitations: PUMS shows the mix of household size and income only at PUMA level (45 areas), so every tract in a PUMA shares the within-tier mix; the tier counts themselves are the tract's own. CHAS is 2018-2022; PUMS is 2020-2024.
